claims.statement: A contravariant functor F: P^op -> Ban on a finite poset P assigns Banach stalk spaces F(x) and contractive linear restriction operators r_{y,x}: F(y) -> F(x) satisfying identity r_{x,x} = id and chain composition r_{z,x} = r_{y,x} r_{z,y} for all x <= y <= z.
dependencies: Finite poset carrier (P, <=) regarded as a small category.
Banach spaces F(x) with complete norms.
Bounded linear restriction operators with operator norm <= 1.
Presheaf axioms: identity on diagonal and chain composition on comparable triples.
claims.limits: Treats finite posets and strict contravariant functors into Banach spaces; does not assert weak homotopy presheaves or infinite topological manifolds.

claims.statement: Contractive covering-edge maps whose saturated-chain composites are path-independent extend uniquely to a functorial Banach presheaf on all comparable pairs in a finite poset.
dependencies: Finite poset (P, <=) with covering relations a -< b.
Contractive restriction operators r_{b,a} on covering edges.
Path-independence of composites along all alternative saturated chains.
Chain concatenation property for saturated chains.
claims.limits: Requires the path-independence hypothesis on saturated chains; fails if alternative chains produce differing linear operators.

claims.statement: In a strict contravariant functorial presheaf on a finite poset, the two restriction composites around an elementary diamond a < b, d < c agree: r_{b,a} r_{c,b} = r_{d,a} r_{c,d} = r_{c,a}.
dependencies: Elementary diamond subposet a < b, d < c with b != d.
Functorial chain composition law applied to chains a <= b <= c and a <= d <= c.
Existence of direct restriction operator r_{c,a}.
claims.limits: Holds in strict presheaves where composition defect K = 0; non-flat systems incur a non-zero curvature defect.

claims.statement: Local payload observation factors through the payload-only quotient, whereas global curvature fails to factor when two payload-identical packets have different curvature values.
dependencies: Finite packet set carrying local payload and global curvature observables.
Payload equivalence relation p1 ~ p2 iff p1.payload == p2.payload.
Separation of distinct curvature values on identical payload fibers.
claims.limits: Applies to discrete packet spaces and primitive difference quotients; curvature factors when the equivalence relation includes the curvature observable.
